notes.title: Updated Demo
notes.content:
What has changed:

• The tutorial has been enhanced. It now provides a clearer explanation of how abilities work.
• More narration has been added to the game. Both the prologue screens and an in-game side dialogue window offer additional lore for players to explore.
• Leveling up gratitude now grants rewards. As you level gratitude levels, you gain opportunities to unlock coven slots and ability slots. Finally, it pays off to pick up that pesky garbage in the forest!
• You can now purchase power-ups for tree spirits using the in-game currency, mulch.
• A Linux version is now available.
• Item handling has been improved. A "collect all" button has been added to troves, and item stats have been adjusted to encourage players to review and compare them for the most desirable bonuses.
• The puzzle selector has undergone a slight revamp.
• FPS and overall stability have been improved.
